Application rules

Do's & guardrails
01

Navy leads, always

Prime Navy should anchor every layout as the dominant color â€” matching the logo's own weight â€” for headers, primary buttons & brand backdrops.

02

Gold is earned, not everywhere

Prime Gold carries the crown's meaning of quality. Use it for the logo, one accent per screen, or premium touches â€” never as a large fill.

03

Slate for everyday text

Blue Slate is the working color for body copy and UI on light backgrounds â€” legible and quieter than full navy.

04

Give the logo room & contrast

Always place the mark on paper, white, or its approved navy card â€” never directly on Blue Slate, Amber, or Sand, where contrast drops.
